name: firefox
summary: [Firefox](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/) Browser, also known as Mozilla Firefox or simply Firefox, is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation and its subsidiary, the Mozilla Corporation. Firefox uses the Gecko layout engine to render web pages, which implements current and anticipated web standards.

ports.description: Firefox desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

env.name: FIREFOX_CLI
env.description: Specify one or multiple Firefox CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

custom.description: This is needed for any modern website to function like youtube.

The application can be accessed at:

changelog.text: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Suppress sandbox security warning as it's misleading inside a container.
Add proper cleanup logic for builds.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS is now required.
Add ability to pass CLI args to Firefox.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Rebase to Alpine 3.15, stop using ESR.
